description_en: Initiates an intelligent interactive voice response call. Intelligent interactive voice response is a human-computer interaction technology that allows users to have natural conversations with machines by using voice
description_zh: 智能语音交互服务，是一种人机交互技术，它允许用户通过语音与机器进行自然的对话和沟通
name: SmartCall

parameters.help_en:
The caller ID displayed to the called party. The number must be a purchased number.

You can log on to the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home) and view purchased numbers on the Voice Numbers > Real Number Management page
parameters.help_zh:
被叫显号。必须是已购买的号码。

您可以登录语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home)，在语音号码>真实号管理页面查看已购买的号码
parameters.name: called_show_number

parameters.help_en: The called number. Only numbers in the Chinese mainland are supported
parameters.help_zh: 被叫号码。仅支持中国内地号码
parameters.name: called_number

parameters.help_en:
The audio file played during the intelligent outbound call.

If the audio file is uploaded to the console, set the VoiceCode parameter to the voice ID of the file. You can logon to the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home), choose Voice File Management > Intelligent interactive voice response audio files, and click Details to view the corresponding Voice ID
parameters.help_zh:
智能外呼放音文件。

当放音文件为控制台上传的语音文件时：参数VoiceCode指定为文件的语音ID。您可以登录语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home)，选择语音文件管理>智能语音交互放音文件，单击详情查看对应的语音ID
parameters.name: voice_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to record the call. Valid values:

true: Record the call.
false: Do not record the call
parameters.help_zh:
通话过程中是否录音。取值：

true：录音。
false：不录音
parameters.name: record_flag

parameters.help_en: The volume for user audio playback. Valid values: -4 to 4. The recommended value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 播放用户音频的音量。取值范围：-4~4，建议设置为1
parameters.name: volume

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 参数暂不支持使用
parameters.name: speed

parameters.help_en:
The automatic speech recognition (ASR) model. Valid values:

customer_service_8k (default): Mandarin.
dialect_customer_service_8k: Heavy accent.

When you call the SmartCall API, you must specify the ASR model to use. Specify either AsrModelId or AsrBaseId.
If only AsrModelId is specified, the specified ASR model is used.
If only AsrBaseId is specified, the specified ASR foundation model is used.
If neither is specified, the default ASR foundation model is used. The default value of AsrBaseId is customer_service_8k, which indicates the ASR Mandarin foundation model.
If both are specified, make sure that they correctly correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh:
ASR模型。取值：

customer_service_8k（默认）：普通话。
dialect_customer_service_8k：重口音。

调用SmartCall接口时需要指定使用的ASR模型，建议参数AsrModelId和AsrBaseId二者选填其一。
如果仅设置AsrModelId，表示使用指定的ASR模型。
如果仅设置AsrBaseId，表示使用指定的ASR基础模型。
如果二者均未设置，则使用默认的ASR基础模型，即参数AsrBaseId默认为customer_service_8k，表示使用ASR普通话基础模型。
如果二者同时设置，请确认二者是正确对应的
parameters.name: asr_model_id

parameters.help_en:
The pause duration. This parameter specifies how long a user must pause to indicate the end of a sentence. Unit: milliseconds. Valid values: 300 to 1200.

If the specified value is out of the valid range, the default value 800 is used.
This parameter takes effect only when it is set for the first time. Subsequent settings are invalid
parameters.help_zh:
停顿时长。用于设置用户停顿多久表示一句话结束。单位：毫秒，取值范围：300~1200。

如果指定值不在参数范围中，则该参数默认取值为800。
该参数首次设置有效，后续设置无效
parameters.name: pause_time

parameters.help_en:
The mute duration. This parameter specifies how long a user can remain silent before the call ends. Unit: milliseconds. Valid values: 1000 to 20000.

If the specified value is out of the valid range, the default value 10000 is used.
This parameter can be dynamically set during the call. The last setting prevails
parameters.help_zh:
静音时长。用于设置用户多久不说话通话结束。单位：毫秒，取值范围：1000~20000。

如果指定值不在参数范围中，则该参数默认取值为10000。
通话过程中可动态设置，以最后一次设置为准
parameters.name: mute_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the currently returned media file can be interrupted. Default value: true, which indicates that the media file can be interrupted.

If this parameter is set to false, the current audio playback cannot be interrupted even if the next action_break is set to true.

The priority of action_code_break is higher than that of action_break
parameters.help_zh:
当前返回的媒体文件是否可以被打断。默认取值为true，即可被打断。

如果为false，即使下一个动作action_break为true，也无法打断当前放音。

action_code_break优先级高于action_break
parameters.name: action_code_break

parameters.help_en:
The custom ID provided for the caller. This ID is returned to the caller in the receipt message.

The value must be a string and 1 to 15 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh:
预留给调用方使用的ID。 最终会通过在回执消息中将此ID带回给调用方。

字符串类型，长度为1~15个字节
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en: The custom dynamic extension ID provided for the caller. This ID is returned in the callback URL and used as a development identifier for the customer
parameters.help_zh: 预留给调用方使用的动态扩展ID。在回调地址中带回，用于客户的开发标识
parameters.name: dynamic_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable early media speech recognition. Valid values:

false (default): Disable early media speech recognition.
true: Enable early media speech recognition.

If this parameter is set to true, the reason why the call is not answered is recorded
parameters.help_zh:
早媒体语音识别标识。取值：

false（默认）：关闭。
true：开启。

设为true会记录通话未接听的原因
parameters.name: early_media_asr

parameters.help_en: The text-to-speech (TTS) parameter string in JSON format. The parameters must correspond to the TTS parameters of VoiceCode
parameters.help_zh: TTS参数传递字符串，格式为JSON。必须与VoiceCode的TTS参数对应
parameters.name: voice_code_param

parameters.help_en:
The maximum call duration. The call is automatically hung up after the timeout period. Unit: seconds.

The maximum call duration is 3,600 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
最大通话时长，超时后自动挂断。单位：秒。

通话时长最长3600秒
parameters.name: session_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The continuous speaking duration of the user that triggers an interruption. Unit: milliseconds.

If ActionCodeBreak of the current media file is set to true, the current playback can be interrupted when the user speaks continuously. If this parameter is not set or is set to 0, it does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
基于用户持续说话时长打断。单位：毫秒。

如果当前媒体文件ActionCodeBreak为true，用户持续说话可以打断当前播放。不设置或者为0，不生效
parameters.name: action_code_time_break

parameters.help_en: The voice style used for TTS variable playback. Default value: xiaoyun. For more information, see the voice style list
parameters.help_zh: TTS变量播放时的声音风格。默认为xiaoyun。具体风格，请参见下表声音风格列表
parameters.name: tts_style

parameters.help_en: The volume for TTS variable playback. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: TTS变量播放的音量。取值范围：0~100，默认值为0
parameters.name: tts_volume

parameters.help_en: The speech rate for TTS variable playback. Valid values: -200 to 200. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: TTS变量播放时的声音速度。取值范围：-200~200，默认值为0
parameters.name: tts_speed

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to configure TTS voice parameters. Valid values:

true: Configure TTS voice parameters. You must use the TtsStyle, TtsVolume, and TtsSpeed parameters to configure the voice style.
false: Do not configure TTS voice parameters. You do not need to configure the related parameters. Even if they are configured, they do not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
是否设置TTS声音参数。取值：

true：设置。需要通过TtsStyle、TtsVolume、TtsSpeed三个参数来设置声音风格。
false：不设置。不需要设置相关参数，即便设置了也不生效
parameters.name: tts_conf

parameters.help_en:
The ASR foundation model. Valid values:

customer_service_8k (default): Mandarin.
dialect_customer_service_8k: Heavy accent.

When you call the SmartCall API, you must specify the ASR model to use. Specify either AsrModelId or AsrBaseId.
If only AsrModelId is specified, the specified ASR model is used.
If only AsrBaseId is specified, the specified ASR foundation model is used.
If neither is specified, the default ASR foundation model is used. The default value of AsrBaseId is customer_service_8k, which indicates the ASR Mandarin foundation model.
If both are specified, make sure that they correctly correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh:
ASR基础模型。取值：

customer_service_8k（默认）：普通话。
dialect_customer_service_8k：重口音。

调用SmartCall接口时需要指定使用的ASR模型，建议参数AsrModelId和AsrBaseId二者选填其一。
如果仅设置AsrModelId，表示使用指定的ASR模型。
如果仅设置AsrBaseId，表示使用指定的ASR基础模型。
如果二者均未设置，则使用默认的ASR基础模型，即参数AsrBaseId默认为customer_service_8k，表示使用ASR普通话基础模型。
如果二者同时设置，请确认二者是正确对应的
parameters.name: asr_base_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable streaming ASR, which intelligently determines the semantics based on the first few words spoken by the user. Valid values:

0: Disable streaming ASR.
1: Enable streaming ASR
parameters.help_zh:
流式ASR，根据用户说的前几个字智能判断语义。取值：

0：关闭。
1：开启
parameters.name: stream_asr

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the background audio file played during the conversation between the user and the robot.

You can logon to the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home), choose Voice File Management > Intelligent interactive voice response audio files, and click the Details button to view the corresponding voice ID
parameters.help_zh:
用户和机器人对话时播放的背景语音文件ID。

您可以登录语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home)，选择语音文件管理>智能语音交互放音文件，单击详情按钮，查看对应的语音ID
parameters.name: background_file_code

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 参数暂不支持使用
parameters.name: background_volume

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 参数暂不支持使用
parameters.name: background_speed

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform inverse text normalization (ITN) during post-processing. Default value: false, which indicates that ITN is not performed.

If this parameter is set to true, Chinese numerals are converted to Arabic numerals in the output
parameters.help_zh:
是否在后处理中执行ITN。默认为false，即不执行。

设置为true时，中文数字将转为阿拉伯数字输出
parameters.name: enable_itn

parameters.help_en: The NoiseThreshold
parameters.help_zh: The NoiseThreshold
parameters.name: noise_threshold

CallId.description_en:
The unique receipt ID of the call.

You can call the [QueryCallDetailByCallId](~~QueryCallDetailByCallId~~) API operation to query the call details by using the CallId
CallId.description_zh:
此次通话的唯一回执ID。

CallId可以通过[QueryCallDetailByCallId](~~QueryCallDetailByCallId~~)接口查询呼叫详情

Code.description_en:
The status code of the request.
A value of OK indicates that the request is successful.
For other error codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）

Message.description_en: The description of the status code
